description: Use this when you need a ToolForte tool that is not in the current tool list. Example prompt: "Is there a tool that converts YAML to JSON?" Find ToolForte tools by what you want done, for example "iban", "vat", "pdf merge", "working days", "csv to json", "screenshot". ToolForte has over a hundred exact tools (validation, conversion, Dutch tax and dates, test data, files, AI); a session lists a small core of them and this is how you reach the rest. Returns the best matches with their arguments and cost. Then call the tool by name, or through run_tool. Free. The answer is deterministic.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 1 to 50 (default 8)

query.description: Words describing the job. Empty lists every tool the server has.

name: search_tools

result.description: The result, when it is not an object

title: Find a ToolForte tool
